description: Reset the coupling time and coupling interval to the starting state. This is used when restarting a coupled calculation. When a model state (SAV) file that already contains elements is restored, this command should be given before giving the “cfd connect” or “cfd slave” commands.

examples.description: Reset the coupling time when restarting a coupled run

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): accepted on all three consoles.
